description:
Generation-unit unavailability events (UMM).

`start`/`end` default to UTC; `start` inclusive, `end` EXCLUSIVE. An
outage is returned if it overlaps the window. Pass `tz="local"` or an
IANA name to interpret start/end as wall-clock in that timezone.
A zone whose outage feed stopped upstream (GB, 2021-06-15) carries
`series_ended`: outages announced since then are missing, though older
documents may still schedule events into the window.
name: get_outages
title: Get generation outages
